copper.$description: Brand accent for Technical Copper: registration marks, highlights, and focused primary actions.

agentic.useFor: Brand identity, registration stroke marks, interactive accents, and focused keywords
agentic.avoidFor: Large-area backgrounds or unreadable body copy
Text color or card surface fills

surface.$description: Elevated surface (Elevated Graphite) for cards, modals, and container panels.

agentic.useFor: Cards, panel containers, and modals to separate content from base canvas

default.$description: Primary action in a flow, main CTA. Do not use for decorative surfaces or secondary actions.

agentic.useFor: Primary action in a flow, main CTA
agentic.avoidFor: Decorative surfaces, secondary or tertiary actions

primary.$description: Primary text and primary icons (Off-White) for glare-free readability on dark backgrounds.

agentic.useFor: Headlines, main body text, and primary icons

muted.$description: Secondary text, metadata, and dimmed icons (Muted Gray).

agentic.useFor: Metadata, code labels, timestamps, and secondary captions

default.$description: Text on tinted destructive button background (bg-destructive/10). Lighter than standard destructive for contrast >= 4.5:1.

agentic.useFor: Text on tinted destructive button background (bg-destructive/10) - lighter than shadcn default --destructive to maintain contrast >= 4.5:1 against tint background (see ACCESSIBILITY.md)
agentic.avoidFor: Text on solid red background - use shadcn default --destructive-foreground (white) instead

subtle.$description: Subtle structural lines and borders (Subtle Border).

agentic.useFor: 1px structural divider lines, cards, and modal borders

sm.$description: Caption and helper text below fields (e.g. form validation messages).

agentic.useFor: Hilfstext/Caption unterhalb eines Feldes (z.B. FormFields Fehlermeldung)
agentic.avoidFor: Body copy, field labels, or button text - use font.size.md instead

xl.$description: Headline and page title (e.g. Welcome back on login screens).

agentic.useFor: Headline / page titles (e.g. Welcome back on a login screen)
agentic.avoidFor: Body copy, field labels, or button text - use font.size.md instead
Body copy or subtext - do not set weight token, default (400) is sufficient

sm.$description: Line height for small captions, paired with font.size.sm.

xl.$description: Line height for headlines, paired with font.size.xl.

base.$description: CSS font family value for web code. Configured as Geist in Figma.

agentic.useFor: CSS-Wert fuer den Web-Code. Figma kennt denselben Font unter dem Namen "Geist" (ohne "Variable"-Suffix) -- dafuer existiert eine eigene, separat gepflegte Figma-Variable, kein gemeinsamer Sync-Wert moeglich.

mono.$description: Monospace font for code snippets, metadata, and terminal tags.

agentic.useFor: Code snippets, labels, metadata, and uppercase tags
